title: Field, Input, Textarea
description: Field gives any control a label, a hint and an error, wired for screen readers; `kind` sets the phone keyboard, autofill and Enter key of an email, phone, number, money, URL, search or password field. Input and Textarea are the standard text controls (bg-field, h-field).
when: Every form control: wrap it in Field instead of writing a <label>.
Text, email, password, search inside forms; multi-line notes.
An email, phone, number, money, URL, search or password field: set `kind` so phones show the right keyboard.

instead.need: Filter a list in a toolbar
Save / Cancel under the fields, validation timing, warn before leaving

a11y: Field links label (htmlFor), hint and error (aria-describedby) and sets aria-invalid on error.
The error is announced when it appears; required adds a visible mark and aria-required.
kind sets inputMode (the keyboard), autoComplete (autofill) and enterKeyHint (the Enter key label); a prop on the control wins, e.g. autoComplete="new-password" on a sign-up password.

examples.title: Kinds
examples.description: kind="email | tel | number | money | url | search | password" sets type, inputMode, autoComplete and enterKeyHint.

examples.title: Error and required
examples.description: Pass error to show the message under the control and mark it invalid.

examples.title: Overline section labels and reply box
examples.description: Use text-overline text-muted for form section labels (never for a single field), and Textarea resizable for an auto-growing reply box.

notes: kind: email (type email, keyboard with @, autocomplete email), tel (tel keypad), number (decimal keypad), money (decimal keypad: amounts are typed with separators, parse in the app with a locale-aware parser, not Number(); inputMode="numeric" for whole numbers), url (type url: the browser rejects a bare 3dnoobs.vn on submit; next to an https:// addon pass type="text"), search (Enter reads "search"), password (autocomplete current-password, Enter reads "go"). number and money stay type="text": never a native type="number" (use NumberInput for a touch numpad; inside a Field it takes only autoComplete and enterKeyHint from the kind).
Labels sit above the control, required fields get `*` (and "bắt buộc" for screen readers), the error shows under the field (`error`). Page forms are at most max-w-2xl (FORM_PAGE).
